pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with softened, smooth-gradient edges. Patches exhibit a range of sizes, with larger, elongated shapes on the lower neck transitioning to more compact, multi-sided geometries on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-toned pathways. The topology is characterized by clear junction nodes, predominantly three-way intersections, with a relatively consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible torso.
